resume.headline: AI/ML Engineer
resume.summary: AI/ML Engineer with 4+ years of experience across data engineering and applied AI, building grounded LLM applications, agent workflows, and model evaluation on the OpenAI SDK. Built a repository-aware assistant grounding 3 LLMs in static code analysis and benchmarked 2 agent SDKs for a co-authored paper. Holds an M.S. in Applied Computer Science and DP-203 and AWS Cloud Practitioner certifications.

bullets.label: Production Application
bullets.text: Delivers a production inventory application end to end with AI-assisted development, from Supabase PostgreSQL schema design to a deployed JavaScript dashboard on Vercel.

bullets.label: Data Modeling
bullets.text: Models append-only count history with update triggers and indexed lookups, replacing 7 paper and spreadsheet logs with one structured source of record.

bullets.label: Access Control
bullets.text: Secures every table with Supabase Auth sessions and row-level security policies, restricting inventory and vendor data to authenticated access only.

bullets.label: Reorder Logic
bullets.text: Implements parsing logic that normalizes free-form counts against par levels and routes unparseable values to a manual-review queue, keeping reorder alerts trustworthy.

bullets.label: Codebase Assistant
bullets.text: Architected CodeRepoReader AI, a repository-aware assistant deployed as a Flask service on Vercel serverless functions, answering developer questions with GPT-4o and Llama 3.1 70B through the OpenAI API.

bullets.label: Context Grounding
bullets.text: Grounded LLM features in static analysis, parsing 4 languages with Python AST and regex to extract classes, functions, dependencies, and entry points as structured context.

bullets.label: Agent Workflows
bullets.text: Built a CLI agent on the GitHub Copilot SDK with event-driven streaming sessions that clones repositories, collects key files, and generates codebase summaries.

bullets.label: SDK Evaluation
bullets.text: Benchmarked 2 agent SDKs by comparing LLM outputs on context handling, tool integration, and response quality, and co-authored the comparative research paper.

bullets.label: Data Foundations
bullets.text: Engineered Azure Data Factory and Databricks PySpark pipelines consolidating 40+ regional SQL Server sources into Snowflake datasets covering roughly 5 million records for analytics.

bullets.label: Telemetry Standardization
bullets.text: Standardized device identifiers, timestamps, and capacity units with PySpark across raw, validated, and curated S3 layers, producing consistent inputs for downstream analysis.

bullets.label: Reconciliation Automation
bullets.text: Automated source-to-target validation and reconciliation between raw and curated layers, reducing recurring reporting errors by more than 90% across published datasets.

bullets.label: Incremental Processing
bullets.text: Orchestrated incremental loads and controlled backfills over partitioned Parquet on Amazon S3 with AWS Glue, absorbing corrected records without rebuilding full history.

bullets.label: Release Workflow
bullets.text: Shipped pipeline changes through Git and Azure DevOps with code reviews and automated checks, keeping transformation code and configurations traceable across releases.

bullets.label: Production Reliability
bullets.text: Monitored pipeline runs with Amazon CloudWatch alerts and retries, tracing schema changes and source outages to restore affected deliveries with validated outputs.

bullets.label: Forecasting Datasets
bullets.text: Prepared historical utilization datasets for forecasting and scenario analysis, informing capacity recommendations that reduced storage-related escalations by 25%.

emails.subject: Generative AI Engineer | grounded LLM apps and evaluation
emails.body:
Hi Hiring Team,
Greetings of the day.

I am Vamshi Krishna, an AI/ML Engineer with over four years of experience across data engineering and applied AI, building grounded LLM applications and evaluating model outputs. I hold a master's degree in Applied Computer Science and am interested in the Generative AI Engineer position at Clearwater Legal Tech.

At Northwest Missouri State University, I built CodeRepoReader AI, which grounds GPT-4o and Llama answers in static code analysis and runs as a Flask service through the OpenAI API, and I benchmarked 2 agent SDKs for a co-authored paper. Before that, I spent three years at DXC Technology building the data pipelines these systems depend on. This experience aligns with your focus on grounded LLM features and rigorous evaluation of LLM outputs.

I have attached my resume for your consideration. I would welcome the opportunity to learn more about this role and your team, and I look forward to hearing from you regarding the next steps in the hiring process.

Best regards,
Vamshi Krishna Balupari
